notes.title: Cash_Out has been updated to 0.8.4.0 + Authoring Tools Update!
notes.notes:
Nothing major in this update, there was a visual "change" as I fixed a major bug related to saturation issues and lighting, as a result I had to redo some stuff related to lighting.

Anyways here's the patch notes.

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
[*]Did some work on the lab tileset.
[*]Changed the way career mode progression works slightly. Levels will now get larger as well as harder depending on the difficulty level.
[*]Added the option to play modded levels packs in career mode.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a major visual issue related to saturation. Unfortunately, this means I needed to redo a lot of the lighting, everything may look very different. 
[*]Fixed an issue related to sound files in mods.
[*]Pausing no longer removes all the shadows in the room.
[*]Fixed crash caused by unlocking more characters than possible at once.
[*]Fixed an issue related to mods and updating.
[*]Fixed spawning of junk items while modding.[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list]
[*]Visual updates.
[*]Hitsplats/Popups should be easier to read now.
[*]Tightened up the auto-setup again.
[*]You can no longer resize the game screen.
[*]Tweaked the spawn formula for "junk" objects.[/list]

[h1]Modding[/h1][list]
[*]Added the ability to change the ambient and light colour.[/list]

Along with that, some minor work was done with the authoring tools...

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
[*]Added lighting to the room editor to give better visuals.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed a problem where cloned sound files weren't deleted when the game was closed.
[*]Fixed an issue related to dropdowns.
[*]You can now edit sounds that have already been saved.[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list]
[*]Updated the sample mod (changed the sounds, potential copyright issues.)[/list]


Remember to check out the level pack tab under extras if you want to download some level packs to test out!

Next patch is probably going to be a quality of life patch, with some much needed balance tweaks...

Enjoy!

notes.title: Cash_Out Authoring Tools update!
notes.notes:
Sorry, this update was so large it had to be split up into two different updates!

[h1]Additions[/h1][list]
[*]Added the ability to load sounds.
[*]Added the ability to crudely load in scripts, it's text only at the moment.
[*]Added the ability to "copy" and "delete" assets.
[*]Added an indicator to tell if you've saved or not.
[*]Added the basis for updating mods, this isn't totally working due to a problem out my control, but it will be fixed very (?) soon.
[*]Added a bunch of base sprites to use for replacement.
[*]Added the ability to change the background detail sprites.[/list]

[h1]Other Changes[/h1][list]
[*]Greatly optimized filesizes by changing the way sprites are loaded and saved. (Sorry, old images are now corrupt, you can just reload them now.)
[*]Removed the "extra actions" option for objects due to the way scripts are now handled, and how objects are now loaded.
[*]You can no longer save images as .gif.
[*]New assets are no longer just named "asset", but instead are named uniquely (for fast asset adding).
[*]Updated the room visuals.
[*]Updated the taskbar, and bottom taskbar tabs.
[*]Asset names will now automatically update for the rest of the assets when changed.[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed exporting directly not exporting sprites.
[*]Fixed crash caused by exporting to zip twice (steam export was also causing this as it exports to zip).
[*]Fixed a potential issue relating to image encoding.
[*]Fixed a bug where the auto-backup would overwrite the quicksave. (backups weren't even working properly.)
[*]Exporting was also doing this.
[*]Fixed crash caused by replacing a sprite loaded in with a thin sprite, (was causing the number of frames to be 0, attempting to animate it, but the sprite was so small it'd crash, very obscure.)
[*]Fixed room positions.
[*]Fixed room backgrounds not staying over saves.
[*]Fixed dropdowns when there is more than 1 column.
[*]Mod images can now only be bitmaps.
[*]Fixed images not exporting as animated.
[*]Fixed an issue where minimizing would make all windows very small.
[*]Fixed an issue with rooms where minimizing/resizing the window would cause the visauls to break.
[*]Fixed an issue with rooms where minimizing (ingame) would clear the room.
[*]Fixed an issue with rooms where if two windows were open, both rooms would be drawn on the same window.
[*]The slider for the density/brightness no longer defaults at 50% and rounds up, and you can now have more than 1 open.[/list]

notes.title: Small Update, Sale, and Authoring Tools update.
notes.notes:
Generally I don't update like this, but a bunch of stuff has happened at once so I'd like to condense it all into one news post.

To start, a very small update has been pushed for Cash_Out. I noticed that no one was unlocking classes. Most people weren't stealing 5000 dollars. I've changed how classes are unlocked as a result.
You can unlock classes for every 2000 you steal, or 3 raids you attempt. This should make class unlocking much faster.

Along with that, the authoring tools have been updated. Keep in mind they're still very early and  still have a large amount of bugs and issues.

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1][list]
[*]Exporting to steam workshop has been added.
[*]You can now add a room select icon to the level pack.[/list]

[h1]BUG FIXES	[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed crash related to having only one particle on a material.
[*]Pressing cancel when editing an existing level pack no longer takes you to the creation screen.
[*]Fixed an issue with loading rooms.
[*]Changed the way sprites are loaded in initially to ensure that loading always works.
[*]You can no longer select .bmp files as spites. Sorry, they never worked to begin with, only PNG GIF and JPG.
[*]Fixed being unable to rename sprites.
[*]Particles will no longer be spawned if the lifetime is 0.[/list]


Along with that, the game is now on sale for 40% for the rest of the week.

Thanks, and enjoy! ːco_fragː

notes.title: Cash_Out has been updated to patch 0.1.5.0.
notes.notes:
I've changed the way patch notes are posted, since grabbing news posts is now automatic, they won't need to be posted before the patch. Enjoy!


[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
  [*]Enemies now do considerably more damage, but always drop a minihealthkit to make up for it. This is experimental and may be changed.
  [*]Enemies that are alert but don't notice you (are moving after you for example, but haven't reached you) now take minicrits instead of full crits.
  [*]Blocks absorb even more sound now.
  [*]Hostaging mechanics changed.
[list]
	  [*]Enemies now always escape after 8 seconds, regardless of difficulty.
	  [*]During the first 3 seconds the enemy is knocked out and totally silent.
	  [*]During the last 5 seconds, the enemy will wake up and start trying to escape while making sounds that get louder.
	  [*]Knocking out and letting enemies escape takes significantly longer now.
	  [*]Knocked out enemies wake up quicker now too.
	  [*]Knocked out enemies no longer increase the wakeup speed of other nearby knocked out enemies.
[/list]

[h1] BUG FIXES[/h1]
  [*]You can no longer juggernaut charge out of the level.
 [*]Some workshop fixes.
[list]
	 [*]Fixed crash related to workshop upacking.
	 [*]Workshop files will only unpack when they've been updated now.
[/list]

[h1] OTHER CHANGES[/h1]
  [*]Updated the news feed to be automatic, it'll now display the last 3 updates.
  [*]Changed the patch number syntax to be more readable.

I'm going to be (actually) working on mod tools now. I was working on a system for voting on workshop items but I've hit a roadblock. I'd like to get workshop uploading with the authoring tools done soon.

Thanks!
ːco_fragː
